vibe_rationale: Builder-led handmade bicycle show with real community and design curation; an expo format, but culture-first.
fit_notes: Craft-led adult framebuilder and cycling crowd of 7,000 plus, with an active-lifestyle angle and no wellness or health-sector precedent recorded. Five partners, a partnership page and contact email, though the full sponsor roster is not published. A hydration bar or recovery lounge would suit the ethos. Portland-based, so local activation needs a partner.
